info.title: Qos_Pool_Statistics
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

pool_number.description:
Reference Resource: [Qos_Pool_Statistics](#/Qos_Pool_Statistics)
The global pool statistics for the specified pool and traffic manager id

qos_pool_delta_interval.description: The elapsed time (in seconds) since the QoS pool delta_peak  statistics were last read.

qos_pool_delta_peak.description: The largest amount of buffering (in KB) used by the specified  pool and pipeline since the delta_peak value was last read.

qos_pool_headroom_delta_peak.description: Valid only for pools of type 'lossless'. The largest amount  (in KB) used by the shared headroom since the delta_peak value  was last read. Shared headroom is used to store packets received  after pause was sent.

qos_pool_headroom_in_use.description: Valid only for pools of type 'lossless'. The amount (in KB) the  shared headroom is currently using to store packets received  after pause is sent.

qos_pool_headroom_limit.description: Valid only for pools of type 'lossless'. The maximum size  (in KB) of the shared headroom used to store packets received  after pause is sent.

qos_pool_headroom_peak_use.description: Valid only for pools of type 'lossless'. The largest amount  (in KB) the shared headroom has used to store packets received  after pause was sent.

qos_pool_in_use.description: The amount of currently-occupied buffering (in KB) for the  specified pool and pipeline id.

qos_pool_peak_use.description: The largest amount of buffering (in KB) used by the specified pool and pipeline id.

qos_pool_size_limit.description: The maximum amount of buffering (in KB) allocated for the  specified pool and pipeline id.

qos_pool_stats_index.description: A unique index across system for statistics associated to a pool  and pipeline combination

qos_pool_type.description: The type of the specified pool.

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: Columns to display.

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Depth to traverse.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)
